messages:
support-evan: Customer reports 403s from our /oauth/token endpoint after we rotated the signing key yesterday. They use client_assertion JWTs (kid in header) and a JWKS file mounted into their k8s pods via a ConfigMap -> file path in an env var. Some pods accepted the new key, others still present old key and keep failing. Logs attached below.

support-evan: logs snippet: ```
2026-03-10T02:14:23Z oauth: exchange failed client_id=acme-integ err=\"invalid_client: kid not found in keystore\"
2026-03-10T02:14:24Z auth: verify_jwt error: no matching JWK for kid \"b12f-9a7c\"
```

support-evan: repro steps we used: 1) rotate KMS alias (prod/signing-key) via infra 2) update JWKS file in configmap 3) rollout only partially (staggered) -> saw 403s on older pods. Customer claims their client library caches the JWK too.

kate.sre: quick Qs — are these pods using an init container to fetch the JWKS, or are they reading the mounted file on startup? also which sidecar (envoy/sidecar-proxy) version?

support-evan: they use a simple init that writes /etc/jwks/jwks.json from the ConfigMap and sets JWKS_PATH env var. Sidecar is envoy 1.23.0. Some apps appear to read file only at startup.

deploy-bot: rotated KMS alias prod/signing-key -> new version v20260310-1 at 2026-03-10T02:12:09Z

julian.eng: root cause is likely file-based mount + in-process caching. When configmap is updated k8s mounts a new file but processes that opened the previous inode keep the old content until restarted. If client_assertion is produced with old key, our token endpoint will reject with kid not found.

julian.eng: short-term mitigation: rolling restart of the deployment(s) to force processes to pick up the new JWKS file. Long-term: serve JWKS via HTTP endpoint that supports key set with both previous + current keys for a grace window, or add in-process reload when env var points to file.

rachel.security: also note: we revoked the old private key in KMS. If clients are generating client_assertion signed by the new private key and still include old kid in header (misconfigured client), we'd see mismatch too — confirm client JWT header kid and signature alg.

support-evan: confirmed from customer: their client lib uses a cached JWK set and never refreshed — they were still signing with new kid but sending old kid header by mistake (bug). Combined with pods holding old JWKS we got mixed failures. Customer will patch client, but we need an immediate workaround.

kate.sre: I'll schedule a rolling restart for the affected namespace now (low traffic window). Also adding an emergency rule: keep previous public JWK in our JWKS endpoint for 24h after rotation to allow drift. Can infra/ops approve?

ops-bot: scheduled job created: rolling-restart namespace=acme-integ at 2026-03-10T03:00Z by kate.sre

julian.eng: extra note for engineering: if JWKS_PATH is a file, recommend our runtime emit a warning on startup if it detects that value points at a static file and rotation event is detected (or implement inotify reload). Will file an RFC for hot-reload.

support-evan: customer accepted restart and patched their client. Workaround resolved errors after restart. Escalating RFC to eng-runtime for better hot-reload behavior and adding rotation grace window in JWKS endpoint. cc @julian.eng @rachel.security

rachel.security: also suggest documenting recommended rotation procedure in KB: \"rotate private key -> keep previous public JWK published -> wait 1h -> revoke old private key\". I'll draft that. :memo::lock:
